one: Efficient generative models: trade-offs among inference depth, compute, latency, memory, and data, with LLMs as the main case.
pos: MS&E 319 studies the algorithmic problems of generative models under compute constraints. It discusses how objectives, architectures, data pipelines, inference, and serving systems are shaped by compute/latency/memory/data, using LLMs as the main case; students give one presentation and complete a survey or research project.
topics: **Compute constraints**: inference depth, compute, latency, memory, data
**Objectives and architectures**: scaling, sparsity, mixture of experts
prereq: ML/LLM basics; algorithmic and systems awareness.
assess: One presentation plus a survey or research project. Check the current syllabus for details.
who: People who want to work on inference efficiency, generative-model algorithms, or ML systems; graduate students.
tips: Pair with CS 349E for engineering implementation and CS 336 for model training.
